summary: This directory acts as the system initialization and configuration hub, establishing essential service layers for logging, filesystem interaction, and environment-based configuration management to ensure a stable application runtime across different environments.
responsibilities: Load and manage application configuration from environment variables or local files
Provide platform-agnostic service layers for filesystem access
Initialize and standardize global application logging
Define service layers for dependency injection across production and test environments
relationships: Config layers aggregate providers and services to supply dependency injection containers to the application.
Platform layers standardize filesystem access while integrating with logging and configuration services.
The initialization process binds environment-specific providers to the application service graph.
designDecisions: Layer pattern for managing service dependencies and environment-specific implementations
Centralized configuration provider strategy with support for local and environment-based settings
Decoupled logging service with configurable transports for consistent output formatting
